styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids-sneaker ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, beige linen #D9CFBF, charcoal text #2B2B2B and one lemon-yellow accent #FFD900, with cobalt blue #2B62C9 and vivid red #E23A2E reserved for colorway panels only; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; bold geometric sans-serif for single-character impact headlines with one short selling-point line beneath, no dense body text; consistent solid-color info blocks and small numbered badges; consistent thin-line icons and yellow leader dots; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源长图 750px 宽，切片 14 片逐片判读拼合。主产品判定为儿童魔术贴网面运动鞋（红/蓝/黑三色，31-36 码，春秋休闲款）：依据为页首「儿童潮鞋·运动风」主题文案、31-36 码儿童尺码表、模特展示均为儿童脚部/骑行场景；源文件夹仅名为「鞋」且文件名无产品名，故完全以画面内容判定。已剥离源身份元素：鞋身钩形侧身 logo、品牌缩写与货号、全部原印中英文文案（含含年份的促销语）、儿童面部身份、星级评分盾牌图、版权声明行。产品一律以 {product} 占位，文案以 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 占位重建。新版按规范将预留文案空白并入完整构图，信任镜改为实色服务承诺徽章；信息图版式（三宫格、尺码表、信任版）的占比按版式可读性微调并已在对应镜注明。
